'''Zonama Sekot's sun''' was a [[yellow dwarf]] located within the [[Gardaji Rift/Legends|Gardaji Rift]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It formed a [[Trinary star/Legends|trinary star system]] with a [[Unidentified red giant (Gardaji Rift)|red giant]] and a [[Unidentified white dwarf|white dwarf]], both of which were located several [[Light-year/Legends|light months]] away.<ref name="RP" />
